name: @bananaworld/design-system
description: Shared Bananaworld design system + shared pure logic used by both Bananaworld-DC and Bananaworld-CRM. The UI barrel ('.') is the 28 pure UI primitives + per-surface (data-surface) tokens — pure presentation only: no network, no permission/scope logic (TECH-COMP-003 / ADR-001). A separate './pricing' subpath ships THE single shared price-calculation engine (pure, no IO — CRM ADR-007 / PRD-FUNC-060) so a quote and the eventual order price identically; it never imports the UI layer. Shipped as TypeScript source; consumers transpile it via Next.js transpilePackages.
